comingSoon.title: Q&A
comingSoon.subtitle: Coming Soon
comingSoon.description: Q&A is a dedicated space for asking and answering specific questions. Unlike blog posts which are longer-form articles, Q&A is designed for:

features.quick: Quick Questions & Answers - Get straight to the point with focused discussions
features.voting: Community Voting - Upvote or downvote questions and answers to surface the best content
features.tags: Tag-based Organization - Easily find and categorize questions by topics
features.tracking: Answer Tracking - See how many answers each question has received
features.views: View Counting - Track question popularity and engagement

comingSoon.perfect: Perfect for technical troubleshooting, quick clarifications, and building a searchable knowledge base.

comingSoon.title: Journals
comingSoon.subtitle: Coming Soon
comingSoon.description: Journals are a personal logging space for quick thoughts and moments. Unlike blog posts which are structured articles, journals are designed for:

features.quick: Quick Updates - Share your thoughts, progress, or daily notes in real-time
features.media: Rich Media Support - Include both text and images to capture moments visually
features.chronological: Chronological Feed - View entries in timeline order, like a personal diary
features.lightweight: Lightweight & Fast - No complex formatting needed, just write and publish
features.markdown: Markdown Support - Simple text formatting for organized notes

comingSoon.perfect: Perfect for daily logs, project updates, learning notes, or sharing quick thoughts with images.
